reasoning: llm-d Router (formerly Inference Scheduler) is a Go project that builds long-running runtime binaries: the Endpoint Picker (EPP), an ext-proc gRPC server that integrates with Envoy/Gateway API to route LLM inference traffic using prefix-cache and load-aware scheduling; a P/D disaggregation sidecar deployed with model servers; and a coordinator. These ship as container images (Dockerfile.epp, Dockerfile.sidecar, Dockerfile.coordinator) and deploy via Helm charts/manifests. The repo defines some CRDs (InferenceObjective, InferenceModelRewrite) and has a client-go, but the EPP only watches these resources to steer its request handling. It does not reconcile workloads the way an operator does. Its main job is serving data-plane traffic, so it is a service.
